definitions.explanation: Characteristic of or appropriate for a young child; lacking sophistication or maturity.
Relating to the stage of early childhood development (neutral usage).

examples.english: Such a childish excuse won't work.

notes:
USAGE: {幼稚|ようち} has two main contexts:
1. Negative: describing immature or childish behavior in adults (pejorative)
2. Neutral: relating to early childhood education

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {幼稚|ようち}な⟦{考|かんが}え→考え：00855_kangae⟧ (childish thinking)
- {幼稚|ようち}な⟦{行動|こうどう}→行動：02728_koudou⟧ (immature behavior)

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{幼稚|ようち}{園|えん}→幼稚園：04703_youchien⟧ (kindergarten) - very common word using neutral sense

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{子供|こども}っぽい→子供っぽい：16825_kodomoppoi⟧ - childish (more colloquial)
- ⟦{未熟|みじゅく}→未熟：13015_mijuku⟧ - immature, inexperienced
- ⟦{大人|おとな}げない→大人げない：28411_otonagenai⟧ - unbecoming of an adult
